summary: Iteration 5 — Visual + IA refinement (warm saddle/brass palette + grouped sidebar + dashboard hierarchy + mobile FAB) verified end-to-end with no regressions. Login renders new palette correctly; dashboard loads with all 4 sections (Right Now action tiles, Daily Care workflows, Alerts list, Operations Analytics) + setup checklist when incomplete; all required data-testids present (dashboard-page, sidebar, logo, logout-btn, stat-horses/wellness/meds-due/injuries/revenue, setup-checklist-card, resume-setup, 10 checklist-<stepId>, tile-feed/meds/lessons/stall, dashboard-fab). Sidebar shows all 6 grouped sections (Daily, Care, Program, Business, Operations, Insights) with the 22 nav items wired — clicking Barn Setup → /onboarding, Reports → /reports, Barn Board → /barn-board verified. Mobile viewport (390×844): dashboard-fab is visible and navigates to /barn-board on click. Barn Board, Reports (10 funnel rows + nudge-days + KPI strip), and Onboarding (Locations shadcn Select rendered as combobox) all render correctly with the new palette. Zero console errors and zero Tailwind 'unknown class' warnings across all screens — confirms brassLight, saddleDeep, elevated, cream, fade-in-delay-1/2/3, fab, nav-active-rail, scrollbar-luxe, hairline, tap-44, label-eyebrow all compile cleanly. Backend smoke: /api/dashboard/summary, /api/horses, /api/onboarding/progress all return 200 for admin token. No backend changes; pre-existing pytest suites from iter 3+4 not re-run since review_request is frontend-only.

issues: The 'Made with Emergent' badge in the bottom-right of the preview environment overlaps the dashboard-fab when both are at the same corner. Functionally the FAB click still works (verified via scroll_into_view + click), but on a real device the badge would obscure ~50% of the FAB. Consider shifting the FAB position to bottom-24 / left-6 or hiding badge in production. This is a preview-only artifact, not a production regression.

action_items: (Nit) Reposition dashboard-fab on mobile to avoid overlap with the 'Made with Emergent' preview badge (bottom-right), or accept as preview-only artifact.
critical_code_review_comments: tailwind.config.js correctly defines every new color token used by the UI (brass, brassLight, saddle, saddleDeep, taupe, cream, ivory, elevated, tertiary, hairline, graphite). Verified no 'unknown class' warnings in any console log across login/dashboard/reports/onboarding/barn-board.

Sidebar.jsx (140 lines) generates nav-<label> testids deterministically via label.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z]+/g, '-') — 'Barn Setup' becomes nav-barn-setup, 'Barn Board' becomes nav-barn-board. Stable contract for automation.

Dashboard.jsx (305 lines) is at the upper edge of the file-size guideline but still single-responsibility — 4 small sub-components (ActionTile, AlertRow, WeatherCard, UpcomingCard, WellnessPulseCard, PulseRow) co-located makes sense for this view. Acceptable.

FAB uses className 'fab lg:hidden' — verified hidden on lg viewports (1920px) and visible on mobile (390px). Click handler uses useNavigate, not <Link>, which is fine because no right-click semantics needed.
setup-checklist-card guards both progress.completed AND (progress.percent ?? 0) < 100 — defensive and correct.
Reports page renders 10 funnel rows (matches the 10 ONBOARDING_STEPS) and the nudge-days input — admin RBAC still gated by backend require_setup_role from iter 4.

success_rate.backend: 100% (3/3 smoke endpoints; full pytest suites from iter 3/4 untouched)

context_for_next_testing_agent: This iteration was a pure visual/IA refinement — palette + sidebar grouping + dashboard hierarchy + mobile FAB. All data-testids from earlier iterations are preserved. If running mobile Playwright tests, note that the Emergent preview badge can intercept clicks in the bottom-right corner; use scroll_into_view_if_needed() + native click (not force=True) to bypass it, or set viewport height > 1000 so the FAB sits above the badge.
